name: US equity stress
summary: VIX closed at 28.4 on 19 Nov, near the 30 Alert line; S&P 500 8.2% below its high after a 5% weekly fall
state: The VIX closed near 28.4 on 19 Nov, up 47% on the week and close to its 52-week high of 31, but below the 30 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). The S&P 500 ended near 7,176, 8.2% below its 52-week high and 5.1% lower on the week; it fell about 2% on 19 Nov after Fed minutes showed some officials open to larger rate rises (CoinDesk). Chip shares had slipped after Nvidia's results on 18 Nov (TipRanks). Both gauges sit inside the Watch bands.
for_you: US equity markets are in a higher-volatility regime. Pension and investment fund values linked to US shares are more exposed to sharp daily swings than usual.
rubric_hit: Watch: VIX 28.4 within 20–30 and S&P 500 drawdown 8.2% within 5–15%

sources.title: CoinDesk — Bitcoin plunges to lowest since July as broader markets tumble

why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
